h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chittoor

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chittoor

items.pText: Chittoor lies in the south of Andhra Pradesh, close to the Tamil Nadu and Karnataka borders and not far from Tirupati. The district is known for its mango orchards, and many of its schools sit on wide, open plots on the edge of town. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Chittoor's schools, colleges, residential layouts and parks from our factory in Vasai, about 950 km away.

A large school ground gives you choices that a city plot does not. Instead of packing everything into one corner, you can spread equipment into separate areas for different classes, so juniors and seniors play at the same time without crowding. The trade-off is supervision, since teachers need to see each area. We plan layouts that keep the play zones within sight of each other and of the school building.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Spreading equipment across a large school ground

c: Set up two or three zones: one for the pre-primary section with low pieces, one for primary classes with swings, see-saws and slides, and one for older students with climbers. A
makes a good centrepiece for the primary zone.

items.q: Should a large school ground have one play area or several?
items.a: Several zones usually work better, split by age, so different classes can play at once. Keep them within sight of each other so teachers can supervise easily.

items.q: What age group is Paper Boat designed for?
items.a: Our catalogue lists Paper Boat for children aged 5 to 12. It is part of the Kagzi collection in our Funplay Originals range, designed by our own team.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Chittoor?
items.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai, about 950 km away, and send it by road. Our team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs it.
